message: 支えられてこみ上げる想い
Even after everyone found out I was the Demon Lord, the start of the day was the same morning as always.
As usual, Nanaka tells me about the morning TV drama.

name: Nanaka
message: 「So then, right when Kirara is finally about to have her wedding with the one she loves.」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me someone got in the way again?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There are still plenty of days left until the finale, after all. Sure enough, some jerks show up to pick a fight over Kirara's upbringing.」

name: Synn
message: 「C'mooon, just give her a happy ending already! How much do they have to make her suffer before they're satisfied?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It can't be helped. It just means she's done that much to feel guilty about--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, do you feel guilty about being the Demon Lord?」

name: Synn
message: 「...About hiding it from everyone, yeah. Definitely.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. Still, it's not like you were deceiving us to do anything bad, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's true, but.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If you were the type to go, 'Actually, I'm gonna destroy this world!' then I'd be putting my hand to my forehead too, y'know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You couldn't care less about that stuff, though, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, pretty much.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know... the fact that you're the Demon Lord, Synn. It really doesn't bother me at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, Synn is Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm not trying to cheer you up or anything! It's just my honest opinion.\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, if it turned out you were secretly a celebrity or something, Sacchin would probably be over the moon, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's just... well. Remember what Ria-senpai said before?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「N-No, no! It's nothing that shocking, y'know. Just... that she admires the Demon Lord or whatever.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, ahh~~. Yeah, right. She did say that, she did.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Who'd have thought Synn was actually the Demon Lord~? Think she got a li~ttle disillusioned?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, no... I-I-It's just a possibility is all, um, er...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why aren't you snapping back at me like usual?! Why do you look so hurt!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「U-Um... sorry. I took the joke a little too far...」

name: Synn
message: 「If what Nanaka says is true... then I...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You, about Ria-senpai...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You like her, don't you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--?! Wh-wh-wh-wh-wh-why would you say s-something like that.\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Something like that... saying I like her... that's...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I knew it...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...*giggle*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You do like her! It's totally obvious!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm telling you.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't hide it, don't hide it. I'm your childhood friend, you know! I can read whatever Synn is thinking like an open book!」
Just like Nanaka said, I really do like Ria-senpai.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey!! Don't make such a gloomy face!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ow!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You weren't even on her radar until now, and suddenly you've shot straight up to someone she admires--this is your big chance, isn't it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, you're a guy who can get things done when you try. I guarantee it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do your best, Student Council President!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah! Thanks, Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm such a hopeless girl... Acting all tough in front of Synn...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But at this rate, Synn is going to drift further and further away from me. The truth is... I don't want him to become the Demon Lord.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「With a mindset like this... there's no way I can measure up to Ria-senpai...」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hello~~」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, what are you acting all jumpy for?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「He must have a guilty conscience.」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's just... I still haven't properly talked to you about the Demon Lord thing...」

name: Misa
message: 「Indeed. Why did you keep it a secret from us? Perhaps I ought to have you explain yourself until I'm satisfied--」

name: Misa
message: 「Is what I was thinking, but... never mind.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh, it's fine?」

name: Misa
message: 「Just looking at Onee-sama yesterday, it's obvious enough that you aren't our enemy.」

name: Misa
message: 「I am a bit displeased that it was kept secret from me, however, for Onee-sama's sake, I'll forgive you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa...」

name: Misa
message: 「This is a special exception, you hear me?! If you're going to thank anyone, thank Onee-sama!!」

name: Misa
message: 「And never put Onee-sama in danger again.」

name: Misa
message: 「If it's you... you can manage that, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, got it. Are you really sure that's enough, though...?」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph! If my rival turns out to be someone special, that only makes competing against you all the more thrilling.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「No matter how much they call you the Demon Lord, I will surpass you!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Demon Lord or whatever else you may be, just like always--」

name: Misa
message: 「I challenge you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, of course.\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Vice President has made a grand transformation into the Empress of the Underworld, hasn't she?」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you talking about?! At least call me a magical girl, or a witch girl!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you, Lolotte? If there's anything you want to say, feel free to say whatever.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's see~~. So the President is the Demon Lord, right~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When I compare you to the face drawn in the guidebook...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Stare--」

name: Synn
message: 「Ba-dump, ba-dump...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even if you claim to be the Demon Lord, President, it honestly doesn't quite click.」

name: Synn
message: 「*Slump*」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, I do think it's a good thing that you're the Demon Lord, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Why is that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because at the very least, someone standing right in front of me is much more reliable than a being that only exists in stories and books.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, that's true.」

name: Misa
message: 「As long as he isn't inferior to those fictional beings, that is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Urgh.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And besides!! Isn't this what you'd call a hype development, where the final boss becomes an ally?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm not the final boss...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In that case, I'll steel my resolve too. President, lend me your ear.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a secret. Please don't tell anyone!」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Actually, I was an angel all along.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why aren't you surprised!? Isn't this huge news?!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, well, I kind of had a hunch~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-That's strange. Even though the President's coming out made it hard to read the room.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I... I'm glad I confessed.」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder what would have happened if Big Sister hadn't covered for you.\s10」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't even want to imagine...」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, there's an angel standing right next to us. Having a Demon Lord around isn't really that strange. So it wasn't anything to be surprised about.」

name: Misa
message: 「Right, Lolotte the Angel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Like I said, how do you know about that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Both of you... thank you so much.」

name: Misa
message: 「What's with the sudden formality?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Since the President is about to set off on a painful, scary, cold, and grueling training journey, cheering you on this much is an easy task indeed.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Exactly. Now it all comes down to how hard Synn works.」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, sorry to keep you waiting. Is Ria-senpai the only one left?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She's running late today~~」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm... going to go meet her real quick!」
Nanaka, Lolotte, and Misa were there.
Encouraged by my wonderful friends, energy steadily welled up inside me.
My resolve to overcome the harsh trial was set.
And yet...
Why couldn't I feel any real sense of awareness?
Why didn't it feel real?

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa... Where's Senpai...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「President. What are you doing in such a hurry?」

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi-senpai. Is Ria-senpai around?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「She went to take out the trash just a moment ago--」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm back~~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Welcome back. Well then, pardon me for intruding.」

name: Ria
message: 「Bye-by~e♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry, Synn. Did I keep you waiting?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's not like that...」

name: Ria
message: 「What a liar. It's written all over your face that you're tired of waiting.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not so much tired of waiting as eagerly anticipating it, I'd say.」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Let's go, Rea-senpai.\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Starting today, right.」

name: Synn
message: 「Demon Lord training...」

name: Ria
message: 「It's something only you can do, Synn, so you've gotta work hard at it.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn. Don't make such a half-hearted face. Everyone's going to worry, you know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I do have the spirit to see it through. Still, even if I am the Demon Lord...」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you anxious after all?」

name: Synn
message: 「...Y-Yes. I keep wondering what I can even do all by myself at this point. It's never once felt real to me until now.」

name: Ria
message: 「Then why didn't you feel that way until now...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Because I've never been completely alone until now.」

name: Ria
message: 「Completely alone...」

name: Synn
message: 「Until now, everyone was always with me, so I felt like I could do anything...」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka was there, Lolotte was there, Misa was there. And--」

name: Synn
message: 「You were there for me, Rea-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「I see...」

name: Ria
message: 「So, what do you want to do, Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee... Synn-kun, you're surprisingly lonely, aren't you♪」

name: Ria
message: 「Then you just have to ask them. Tell them you can't even get started unless everyone's with you.」
I see. I just let my impatience get way ahead of me. And that only made my anxiety pile up.
It didn't feel real because I was trying to do it all by myself.
Doing things all alone is something I could never pull off no matter how hard I tried.
I never knew how to start anything all on my own.

name: Synn
message: 「Aah... Consulting you really was the right call, Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem! Being relied on is part of a senpai's job, after all♪」
Not just any senpai--it's because it's Ria-senpai...

name: Ria
message: 「Eh, did you say something?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nothing at all!\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So, um... I want you guys to join me, too. For the Demon Lord training.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guess we got no choice!」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, I suppose it can't be helped.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It really can't be helped~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone... Thank you so much!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, is it something even we can actually do?」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course we can.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am super curious about what kind of things we will be doing~~\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「This really is how it ought to be... right?\s04」
With this, I no longer have any doubts or hesitation.
Nothing can start without everyone in the Crusaders.
Ria-senpai, who immediately helped me realize that, understands me so deeply.
I really am in love with Ria-senpai, after all.
Only now have I finally realized it--that I want her to stay by my side forever.

name: Melilot
message: 「Welcome. I have been expecting you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Melilot-san. Thank you for having us today.」

name: Melilot
message: 「There are more of you than scheduled, surely you haven't come here to play around, have you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Melilot-san. Please, um... train us too!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Since when did you start carrying Demon blood?」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That's not what I meant......」

name: Melilot
message: 「Sakura-kun's goal is to master magic in order to become a true Demon Lord.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Therefore, those of you who aren't even Demons cannot wield it. You understand what I'm saying, don't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-W-We do have an angel here, you know.\s01」

name: Melilot
message: 「In that case, practicing Spirit Arts would likely be the wiser choice.」

name: Misa
message: 「But if Sakura-kun can do it, then I can--」

name: Melilot
message: 「Unfortunately, you all do not meet the prerequisites.」

name: Misa
message: 「E-Even so......」

name: Melilot
message: 「Besides, the results of one's efforts aren't determined by prerequisites, but measured through the training ahead.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, we've always done things together.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The Crusaders only work when Synn and all of us are together!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What is it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Very well.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed. Knowing the enemy's hand is also a good opportunity to increase your chances, isn't it.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And the synergy of morale will certainly not go to waste either.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I will permit your participation. However, if we are going to do this, we will do it thoroughly. I have no intention of doing things halfway.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's just what we want! Right, everyone!!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes!」

name: Melilot
message: 「See to it that you never waver in that resolve.」

name: Ria
message: 「Of course!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「And no matter how hurt Sakura-kun gets, you are not to lend a hand. Understood?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll be fine, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah...! Understood.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then, let us begin.」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes!!」
With everyone from the Student Council watching over me, my special training went on for hours.
It started with a lecture from Melilot-san, and then moved on to practical exercises.
All I had to do was have a staring contest with Melilot-san.
However, the room was so overwhelmingly silent that you could literally hear the sound of someone gulping.
Even so, having everyone watching over me gave me encouragement.
To be honest, a fatigue even worse than pulling an all-nighter for a test was washing over me.
Just imagining what it would have been like if I were alone was terrifying.
Before I knew it, the sun had set.

name: Melilot
message: 「...That concludes today's regimen. Good work today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hah... hah...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Let us properly begin with a greeting and end with a greeting. Good work today.」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Good work todaaay~~\s01」

name: Synn
message: 「*Wheeze, wheeze*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn... want me to carry you home on my back?」

name: Synn
message: 「No! I'm fine... hah, hah...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, it's not like I could actually give you a piggyback ride anyway...」

name: Synn
message: 「This is going to continue every day from now on... I can't be getting carried around starting on day one.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You didn't look like you were moving around all that much, so what is it that makes you so tired?」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess you could call it mental training... It feels like I'm fighting back against having my rational thoughts stripped away.」

name: Misa
message: 「Does that mean your mind is being encroached upon by the power?」

name: Synn
message: 「Close. It doesn't seem to want to lend its strength to my goal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Demons are creatures that naturally act on their own desires, after all. They want to use magic power to fulfill their wishes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on a second. Then does that mean my own will is actually conflicting with itself?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's your subconscious. That stuff's all unconscious, so there's no way to know.」
My wish... my true desire, huh...

name: Paqy
message: 「Though, that Melilot woman has probably gone through the exact same kind of training, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I mean she suppresses her desires to carry out another objective. She probably knows she's forcing you to do the same, Demon Lord.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, on the flip side, if we can figure out what your desire is, Demon Lord...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we can?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What will happen?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It might just become the trigger to unleash your maximum power.」

name: Misa
message: 「You heard him, Sakura-kun!! Come on, confess!!」

name: Synn
message: 「E-Even if you tell me that...\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Isn't it something like wanting to eat a beefsteak?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, it's definitely not that.\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What do you think, Senpai?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai, Ria-senpai!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「You're going to walk right past your house.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah! Aaaah! Right, right. Soooorry~\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「I guess I focused a bit too hard and wore myself out. As your senior, I really ought to keep it together.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「I'd better get to bed early tonight. Goodnight♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though she was only watching, she looked terribly exhausted, didn't she.」

name: Misa
message: 「Could it be that Big Sister's consciousness was nearly hijacked as well!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no way something like that happened. Come on, let's hurry up and head back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew~~. That was a great bath.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You'd better bundle up properly after a bath or you'll catch a cold.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, how rare. For you to be looking out for me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Don't get the wrong idea. It's just that there's a girl who'd worry if the Demon Lord collapsed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy... thank you.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... I can't let the two of you get any closer than this!」

name: Synn
message: 「So, who is this person?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Like hell I'd tell you!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, it's the phone.」

name: Paqy
message: 「If someone's going out of their way to call at this hour, it's gotta be that girl.」

name: Paqy
message: 「This is where the great me gets in the way and tears their relationship to shreds--」

name: Paqy
message: 「No, wait! She definitely called because she's worried about the Demon Lord!」

name: Paqy
message: 「If she finds out she can't talk to him, she's bound to be heartbroken. The great me can't do something like that!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Still, if I just leave them alone like this, she and the Demon Lord will...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Uwooooh, what a dilemmmmaaaaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What are you doing?」

name: Paqy
message: 「No, no, the great me will definitely get this one!」

name: Synn
message: 「Just don't do anything rude, okay?」
Now then, before going to bed, I head over to the TV to go save Hiroshi for a bit.

name: Synn
message: 「That was quick. Who was it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It was Soba.」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka?」

name: Paqy
message: 「She was saying stuff like, 'Make sure you don't forget your homework tomorrow!'」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah, that's it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see.」
I can't imagine Nanaka calling just for something like that. What did she really want?

name: Synn
message: 「Should I call her back...」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, is that Nanaka?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hello, Grand Palace Sakura~」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「...! R-Ria-senpai?」
Just hearing her beloved voice made my heart race.

name: Ria
message: 「Ah... I knew it, you're still... feeling worn out, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no! I'm totally fine, really!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's just that you always end up collapsing whenever we're on the phone... so I was worried what I'd do if it happened again this time...」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm always making you worry... I'm really sorry.」
Right.
No matter how much I like her, Senpai is just looking out for me like a good upperclassman.
I'm sure this phone call, too, is just her doing what any senpai in her position would do.

name: Ria
message: 「No, it's fine. I'm glad... You sound well, and I'm really glad.」
Do I like Ria-senpai just because she worries about me...?
Just because I want to be spoiled by my senpai?

name: Ria
message: 「I... during special training today... the whole time, you know, I was watching you, Synn-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh... w-well, I mean... I was just observing, after all...」

name: Ria
message: 「You've been working so hard this whole time, Synn.」

name: Ria
message: 「And the whole time, you looked like you were in so much pain... I...」

name: Ria
message: 「Even so, I... couldn't be of any help at all...」

name: Ria
message: 「Melilot-san saw right through me. How I always want to jump in and lend you a hand right away...」

name: Ria
message: 「Even though lending a hand doesn't mean I can actually do anything...」

name: Ria
message: 「Even though it's not like I can truly share that pain with you...」
I see... I've been relying on her way too much all this time.
Senpai is probably struggling because she can't stop babying her underclassman.
Right.
The only reason she worries about me is because I'm her underclassman.
Even so, man! I don't want us to stay in a relationship like this anymore.

name: Synn
message: 「That's... probably my fault, for relying on you so much all this time, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「No, it's not! All I've ever done is stick my nose where it didn't belong!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, it was reassuring. Just having you there, Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「Just your presence alone gives me more than enough strength. Even without reaching out directly, just having you by my side makes me--」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「To you, I might only look like a high-maintenance underclassman, Senpai. But...!」

name: Synn
message: 「Please keep believing in me and watching over me from here on out!」

name: Synn
message: 「The words you told me, Ria-senpai. I swear I'll live up to them.」

name: Synn
message: 「That it's not because I'm the Demon Lord--it's something I can do because I'm me.」
Wait, what am I doing preaching my heart out into a phone~~!\s01

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry! I-It kinda sounded like I was trying to act cool--」

name: Ria
message: 「No... It was really wonderful...」

name: Ria
message: 「What you just said... made me really, really happy. Uuugh~~\s03 Goodnight!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? W-Wait, Ria-senpai!? Senpai--!?」
Whoa... I really went and did it...
Just because I ran out of things to say, blurting out something so embarrassing in the heat of the moment
My heart is still pounding.
Ever since I realized I'm in love with Ria-senpai, I've been like this nonstop.
Still, just hearing her voice makes me so happy and overjoyed
Simply talking on the phone isn't enough to satisfy me anymore
I want to be with Ria-senpai more and more.
The exhaustion that had filled my mind is gradually painted over by my growing feelings for Ria-senpai.
